newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Xerox said downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Xerox said downgraded.

text.p: -- Smith Barney downgraded Xerox Corp to neutral from outperform, a trading source said.

-- Smith Barney analyst Peter Enderlin confirmed the downgrade. He cited the ending of Xerox's pact to sell Talegen Holdings Insurance Business to Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co and Eastman Kodak Co's recent pact to sell its copier marketing and service operations to Britain's Danka Business Systems Plc. "That increases the competition across the board."
-- The analyst also noted Xerox stock is approaching its high. "It's been a strong performer."
